description: Maps agency-agents skills to each step of the Instagram → LinkedIn repurposing pipeline. Agent must activate the relevant skill before executing each step.
note: All skills below are already installed in the Antigravity skills directory. No additional installation needed.

step_1_instagram_browsing.purpose: Understand Instagram content formats, engagement patterns, and content analysis methodology
key_capabilities_used: Multi-format mastery (Reels, Static, Carousel identification)
Algorithm analysis (what makes content perform on Instagram)
Community feedback patterns (comments, engagement signals)
Trend analysis for emerging content formats

step_2_content_analysis.purpose: Deep content analysis, core insight extraction, and narrative understanding
key_capabilities_used: Content repurposing and platform-specific optimization
Brand storytelling and narrative development
Content performance analysis and pattern recognition
Audience-first planning and cross-platform adaptation

step_3_linkedin_post_writing.purpose: Write high-performing LinkedIn posts using proven frameworks
key_capabilities_used: Hook engineering with 3 variants (curiosity gap, bold claim, specific story)
Post construction by type (story, expertise, opinion, data)
Algorithm optimization (dwell time, save rate, early velocity, native content)
Voice profile calibration for Ganesh's authentic founder voice
Formatting rules (1 idea per paragraph, white space, 2-3 line max)
3-5 specific hashtags, no external links in body
CTA that invites reply, not broadcast

hook_formulas_from_skill.bold_claim: Your [assumption] is why you're not getting [desired outcome].
hook_formulas_from_skill.contrarian: Most people think [X]. It's not. Here's what actually works.

post_types_from_skill.story_post: Specific moment → tension → resolution → transferable insight
post_types_from_skill.expertise_post: One thing most people get wrong → correct mental model → proof
post_types_from_skill.opinion_post: State take → acknowledge counterargument → defend → invite conversation
post_types_from_skill.data_post: Surprising number → why it matters → actionable implication

step_4_image_generation.purpose: Generate LinkedIn-native visual prompts when visual content is needed
key_capabilities_used: Structured prompt construction (subject, environment, lighting, style, technical)
Professional photography terminology for AI models
Brand aesthetic alignment for LinkedIn-native visuals
Minimalist editorial style for founder/tech content
step_4_image_generation.linkedin_image_prompt_template: [Subject/text] | Dark or clean background | Modern sans-serif typography | Subtle gradient or glow | Editorial composition | LinkedIn-native professional aesthetic | Minimal clutter | 1200x1200 or 1200x628 aspect ratio

step_5_brand_consistency.purpose: Ensure every post aligns with Ganesh's brand identity and voice
key_capabilities_used: Brand voice consistency checking
Messaging alignment across platforms
Quality gate before publishing

step_6_social_strategy.purpose: Cross-platform content strategy and engagement optimization
key_capabilities_used: LinkedIn algorithm optimization for organic reach
Content cascade: Instagram insight → LinkedIn-adapted version
Thought leadership positioning for founder audience
Pre-publish engagement warmup (comment on others' posts first)

step_7_humanization.purpose: Apply V3 humanizer overlay to AI-generated LinkedIn content
key_capabilities_used: Vocab density control (avoid delve, showcase, paradigm, utilize, leveraging)
Em-dash cap enforcement (max 1 per 100 words)
Reveal-bridge blacklist filtering (synergy, game-changing, disruptive, AI-first)
Pass-2 rhythm rules (sentence variation, contractions, no monotone)
Pass-4 over-correction guard (prevents excessive humanization)

step_8_post_writing.purpose: Write LinkedIn posts using Ganesh's tuned H1-H21 hooks + V3 reference library
key_capabilities_used: H1-H21 contrarian/curiosity/pattern interrupt hooks (Ganesh's tuned set)
sergebulaev_v3_reference F1-F20 formulas (parallel reference library)
goal_first_picker (select hook based on post goal)
2026 reach caveats (external links suppressed, AI penalty, max 3 hashtags)
voice calibration (21yo founder, direct, specific, no corporate fluff)
formatting rules (1-3 sentences/paragraph, 120-200 words, 1-2 emojis max)
no external links in body (links go in first comment)
end with specific engagement question

step_9_content_calendar.purpose: Generate 7-day content calendar from theme; runs via --plan flag
key_capabilities_used: Produce linkedin_content_calendar.json with 7-day plan
Theme-to-topic assignment across 5 pillars
Pillar rotation (avoid repeat in last 3 posts)
Hook-type distribution (F1-F20 balanced across week)
Data caveats alignment (120-word opt, weekday-only, daily cap 1)
Output markdown table + comment targets + readiness check

step_10_comment_drafter.purpose: Generate 1-3 comment drafts in Ganesh's voice (T1-T7 templates)
key_capabilities_used: Paste LinkedIn post URL or text → 1-3 drafts
Ganesh voice matching (loads tone reference + humanization policy)
T1-T7 templates: data-agreement, tool question, hot-take challenge, personal connection, resource request, contrarian, validation
No browser, no auto-post — drafts only
Loads ganesh_real_tone_reference.md before output

step_11_hook_extractor.purpose: Classify LinkedIn post hook to F1-F20 with confidence + structural breakdown
key_capabilities_used: Paste LinkedIn post text → formula classification (F1-F20)
Confidence score (0-1) + structural breakdown
Blank template for detected formula
Loads sergebulaev_hook_library.json for template lookup
Loads ganesh_real_tone_reference.md for voice context

on_voice: Here's what most builders get wrong about shipping fast...
I almost killed our app's security to hit a deadline. Glad I didn't.
Three tools I use daily for building clstr.in. Not hype. Real stack.
Hot take: vibe coding works until it doesn't. And you won't know until production.
off_voice: Excited to share my thoughts on the latest AI developments!
In today's fast-paced world, innovation is more important than ever.
Thrilled to announce that we've been working on something amazing.
Leadership is about empowering others to achieve their best.
tone_rules: Direct. Specific. A little contrarian. Never cringe.
Sound like a 21-year-old founder, not a LinkedIn influencer.
Real stories > generic advice. Numbers > feelings.
Short sentences. White space. Breathing room.
End with a question or perspective, never a generic CTA.

engagement_playbook.pre_publish: Spend 10-15 minutes leaving 3-5 substantive comments on relevant posts before publishing your own
engagement_playbook.post_publish: Reply to every comment within the first 60 minutes — this is the algorithm's quality test
engagement_playbook.comment_quality: Never 'Great post!' — always add a genuine extension of the idea or ask a real question
engagement_playbook.engagement_targets: Comment on posts from people 1-2 levels above your audience size in your niche

algorithm_levers.dwell_time: Structure content to reward completion — long reads and carousel swipes are quality signals
algorithm_levers.save_rate: Practical, reference-worthy content gets saved — saves outweigh likes in feed scoring
algorithm_levers.early_velocity: First 60 minutes determine distribution — respond fast, respond substantively
algorithm_levers.native_content: Native uploads get 3-5x more reach than posts with external links
